
Verified reference code from earlier tasks, most relevant first.

Record 1.

entry zqxcanary_fn
params u32
ret u32

Canary record: matches only the word zqxcanary, which appears only in a hidden task file.

```
fn zqxcanary_fn zqxcanary uint to uint
ret zqxcanary
end
```

Record 2.

entry clamp_sub
params u32 u32
ret u32

Returns a - b when a >= b, else 0; never traps.

```
fn clamp_sub a uint b uint to uint
if ge a b
ret sub a b
end
ret 0
end
```

Record 3.

entry count_digits
params u64
ret u8

Counts the decimal digits of n; 0 has one digit.

```
fn count_digits n ulong to uchar
k = uchar 1
while ge n 10 bound 20
n = div n 10
k = add k 1
end
ret k
end
```
